adapter_evidence.direct_sql: SQL ALTER owns operation identity; direct typed schema and native ordered DuckDB source/target evidence in task_158_ordered_alter.rs and task_158_frozen_cases.rs
adapter_evidence.dbt_compiled: A dbt compiled model is SELECT-backed: compiled ALTER TABLE model SQL is explicitly rejected at the parser boundary, not silently converted into a write. dbt manifest/catalog provide authoritative metadata for the eight case SQL ALTER replay in task_158_adapter_parity.rs; separate SQL inputs own DDL lifecycle.
adapter_evidence.odcs: ODCS supplies typed prestate only, never inferred ALTER lifecycle. task_158_adapter_parity.rs checks the same eight variants plus constrained key with explicit SQL statements.
adapter_evidence.limitation: A dbt model's compiled SQL cannot act as an arbitrary ALTER DDL program. SQL ALTER is an independent input; dbt and ODCS provide typed prestate metadata only. 13x8 dialect tests classify AST normalization, not runtime. Vendor casts/keys remain TASK-158 Residual.
